prediction_point: after checkout and payment submission, before approval or dispatch
population: delivered orders with actual and estimated delivery timestamps

history_features.rule: each order uses only earlier orders whose delivery (route) or carrier handover (seller) was recorded before its purchase

retired_features.purchase_month: removed after validation: at most one earlier year per month; kept in the table for reference only

classification_rule: actual delivery calendar date > estimated delivery calendar date
regression_rule: elapsed days from purchase timestamp to actual delivery timestamp
numeric_missing_policy: median imputation fitted within each training fold
categorical_missing_policy: unknown category assigned without fitted statistics
